sources.role: desktop path roots, input ParamPackages, NAND saves, keys and save states
Flatpak manifest and app data roots
save-state version compatibility and desktop releases

paths.path: ~/.config/azahar-emu/qt-config.ini (portable user/ directory beside the executable takes priority); controller settings are in the [Controls] section and input profiles are ~/.config/azahar-emu/input/<profile>.ini.

qt-config.ini [Controls] and input profiles; each button/axis is a serialized Common::ParamPackage such as engine:keyboard,code:<integer>,toggle:0 or engine:sdl,joystick:<id>,button:<n>,axis:<n>,direction:<positive|negative>.
paths.naming: ParamPackage comma-separated key:value syntax with $0/$1/$2 escaping; profile files are <profile>.ini under input/.

paths.path: ~/.local/share/azahar-emu/nand/user/save/ (account/<128-bit UUID>/<16-hex title id>/0/ or device/<16-hex title id>/0/); SD-card data is ~/.local/share/azahar-emu/sdmc.
paths.naming: Per-title directories use uppercase 16-hex title IDs and the account/device layout created by the savedata factory.

paths.path: Azahar's Save State UI writes .cst files to the user-selected state location (the UI also exposes quick save/load and numbered slots); there is no stable cross-version state directory in the public desktop documentation.
paths.naming: <game/title context>.cst state files; current releases lock states to the Azahar version that created them.
evidence: source:azahar-emu/azahar src/citra_qt/main.cpp and state menu actions

paths.path: 3DS system files are installed as NAND system contents under ~/.local/share/azahar-emu/nand/system/Contents/registered/ (and user/Contents/registered where applicable); this is firmware content, not one BIOS image.
paths.naming: Registered NCA content is selected by NAND title metadata; Azahar does not publish a universal external firmware filename/checksum.

paths.path: ~/.local/share/azahar-emu/keys/prod.keys plus optional title.keys, dev.keys and key_retail.bin.
paths.naming: Exact key names are prod.keys and title.keys; optional dev.keys/key_retail.bin are accepted. Upstream publishes no canonical checksum for user key files.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/org.azahar_emu.Azahar/config/azahar-emu/qt-config.ini; input profiles are in the same per-app config root under input/.
Same [Controls] ParamPackage syntax as native Linux, in qt-config.ini; profiles are input/<profile>.ini.
paths.naming: engine:keyboard / engine:sdl ParamPackages with comma-separated key:value pairs and escaping.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/org.azahar_emu.Azahar/data/azahar-emu/nand/user/save/ and sdmc/ under the Flatpak XDG data root.
paths.naming: account/<UUID>/<TITLEID>/0 and device/<TITLEID>/0 directories; game files are title-defined.

paths.path: User-selected .cst state files in the writable Flatpak data/config location; slots are exposed by the Save State menu.
paths.naming: *.cst; version-locked to the Azahar release that created them.
evidence: source:azahar-emu/azahar state and Qt UI code

paths.path: NAND firmware registered content under ~/.var/app/org.azahar_emu.Azahar/data/azahar-emu/nand/system/Contents/registered/.
paths.naming: NCA registered content selected by NAND metadata; no universal BIOS filename/checksum.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/org.azahar_emu.Azahar/data/azahar-emu/keys/prod.keys plus optional title.keys/dev.keys/key_retail.bin.
paths.naming: Exact names are prod.keys and title.keys; no canonical checksums published.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\azahar-emu\qt-config.ini (portable user\ directory beside azahar.exe takes priority); input profiles are %APPDATA%\azahar-emu\input\<profile>.ini.
qt-config.ini [Controls] using Common::ParamPackage values such as engine:keyboard,code:<integer> and engine:sdl,joystick:<id>,button:<n>/axis:<n>,direction:<positive|negative>.
paths.naming: Comma-separated ParamPackage key:value syntax; profiles input/<profile>.ini.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\azahar-emu\nand\user\save\ (account/<UUID>/<TITLEID>/0 and device/<TITLEID>/0); SDMC is %APPDATA%\azahar-emu\sdmc.
paths.naming: Per-title account/device directories keyed by uppercase 16-hex title ID.

paths.path: Save State menu writes .cst files to the user-selected location; quick and numbered slots are available.
paths.naming: *.cst and version-locked to the creating Azahar version.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\azahar-emu\nand\system\Contents\registered\ for installed 3DS firmware NCA content.
paths.naming: NAND registered-content layout, not a single BIOS file; no universal checksum.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\azahar-emu\keys\prod.keys (+ title.keys, optional dev.keys/key_retail.bin).
paths.naming: Exact names prod.keys/title.keys; no canonical checksum published.

paths.path: ~/.config/azahar-emu/qt-config.ini and input/<profile>.ini; Azahar's POSIX path branch applies on macOS, with a portable user/ directory taking priority.
[Controls] ParamPackages in qt-config.ini; engine:keyboard and engine:sdl joystick/axis/button syntax is the same as Linux.
paths.naming: Comma-separated key:value ParamPackage values; input profiles are <profile>.ini.

paths.path: ~/.local/share/azahar-emu/nand/user/save/ (account/<UUID>/<TITLEID>/0 and device/<TITLEID>/0); SDMC is ~/.local/share/azahar-emu/sdmc.
paths.naming: Per-title uppercase 16-hex title-ID directories.

paths.path: User-selected .cst state files through the Save State menu; states are version-locked.
paths.naming: *.cst; no stable fixed directory documented.

paths.path: ~/.local/share/azahar-emu/nand/system/Contents/registered/ for installed firmware NCA content.
paths.naming: NAND registered-content layout; no universal BIOS filename/checksum.

paths.path: ~/.local/share/azahar-emu/keys/prod.keys (+ title.keys, optional dev.keys/key_retail.bin).
paths.naming: Exact names prod.keys/title.keys; no canonical checksum published.
